en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of an outdoor garden terrace café, with multiple tables and chairs arranged neatly around potted plants and shrubs. The terrace overlooks a rural landscape with green hills and a meadow in the background, in which a cow is grazing. An umbrella stands over one of the tables. The reverse side of the postcard contains printed text and a poem in German, referencing 'Kaffee-Restaurant Langer Grund' and 'Bad Pyrmont', along with a logo for the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'. There are handwritten numbers and some stamps.
